The earlier schedule holds. I re-checked all 14 constraints against it:

- Ann (5) and Ivo (1) are 4 apart.
- Cara (9) and Hana (2) are 7 apart.
- Finn (7) and Hana (2) are 5 apart.
- Gus (3) is right after Hana (2), and Dev (4) is right after Gus.
- Ann (5) is before Elif (6), Ivo (1) is before Finn (7), and Hana (2) is before Ann (5).
- Ben (8) is right after Finn (7).
- Ben (8) and Dev (4) are 4 apart, and Finn (7) and Gus (3) are 4 apart.
- Slot 7 (Finn) is the one person between Ben (8) and Elif (6).
- Slot 8 (Ben) is the one person between Cara (9) and Finn (7).
- Slot 5 (Ann) is the one person between Dev (4) and Elif (6).

The team note is wrong. Hana sits in slot 2, which is early, and Cara is in slot 9, not the opening slot. Cara's constraints are being at least 3 slots from Hana and exactly one person between her and Finn. Only slot 9 fits both. The schedule is also forced. Hana, Gus and Dev must be consecutive, and Ann must come between Hana and Elif. That puts Elif at Hana's slot plus 4, which fixes everything else.
